The About page on phi.ca describes PHI as a not-for-profit organization.

The About page says the gallery is operated by the British Columbia Photography and Media Arts Society, a federally registered charity, and the 2024 annual report treasurer's report on PDF page 45 says the Society operates as The Polygon Gallery.
The Mission and Vision page calls Oakville Galleries a not-for-profit contemporary art museum and the Board page calls its board a non-profit, volunteer group.

basis: The 2023-2024 management report states on PDF page 107 that the museum is a legal person created under the Loi sur les musées nationaux and needs prior government authorisation to acquire, dispose of, mortgage or lease a building, on page 141 that its board approved the budgets, on page 147 that the Vérificateur général du Québec audits it, and on page 148 that it answers access to information requests under the access to documents act.

The auditor's report on PDF page 24 of the 2024-25 annual report names MacKenzie Art Gallery Incorporated and pages 24 to 26 apply the accounting standards for not-for-profit organizations, and the Board and Reports page says members vote for trustees at the annual general meeting.
The About page calls it the Owens Art Gallery (Mount Allison University) and Canada's oldest university art gallery, and the 2023-2024 annual report cover carries the Mount Allison University name.

The City of Saskatoon's 2024 call for board applications on page 1 calls the Art Gallery of Saskatchewan (Remai Modern) a controlled corporation that City Council established under the Non-Profit Corporations Act and says City Council makes the board appointments.

basis: The Rooms Act (2016, chapter R-15.2) sections 3, 5, 10, 13 and 20 continue the corporation as an agent of the Crown, have the Lieutenant-Governor in Council appoint the chief executive officer, tie staffing to the budget approved by the minister and appoint the auditor general as auditor, and the 2023-2024 annual report on PDF pages 51 and 93 confirms the Crown corporation status and government-appointed board.
